svg.aria-label: Wiring of one carrier board: DC in through the buck and the Mini feed, the MCU to the SimpleFOC Mini control header, Mini outputs through the two 30 mΩ shunts to the motor connector with the INA240 taps, CAN transceiver and connectors, encoder ports.
